Submitted. Summary of the repair:

- **Kept the locked status** (deviation) on § 14.2.
- **Minimality fixed**: the single sentence rewrite became a one-word operator flip ("Vendor" → "Customer") plus a short separate insertion carrying the assignment. Both offending extras ("Vendor retains Vendor Technology in accordance with Section 14.3." and "upon its creation") are gone, and the gate now returns ok:true.
- **Preferred level completed on the record**: the embedded-IP licence (perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free — § 13.2, p0049), Vendor's retention of pre-existing IP (§ 14.3), Customer Data retention (§ 14.1) and no joint ownership (§ 14.4) are mapped as already_met with verbatim quotes, so nothing from the fallback bargain was added.
